examples.arabic: الموظف الشاب قال ان سياسات الارجاع تغيرت مع الوقت
examples.english: The young employee said that return policies have changed with time.
examples.transliteration: Al-muwazzafu ash-shaabu qaala inna siyaasaati al-irjaa'i taghayyarat ma'a al-waqti.
examples.storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

examples.arabic: توجهت ليلى بعد ذلك نحو قسم المخطوطات، حيث كان موظف الاستقبال يستعد لإغلاق نافذته للراحة.
examples.english: Layla then headed towards the manuscripts department, where the reception employee was preparing to close his window for a break.
examples.transliteration: Tawajjahat Layla ba'da thalika nahwa qismi al-makhtootat, haythu kana muwaddafu al-istiqbali yasta'iddu li'ighlaqi nafithatihi lilrahat.
examples.storyTitle: Urgent Greetings at the National Library
